title: No sense of how many turns a given hold or path will cost before committing to it — the opening screen warns the main road is ~300 turns and full completion 'many times that,' but nothing in status helps ration a fixed turn budget against that scope, so it's easy (as happened here) to spend the whole budget on 3 of 6 holds plus hub content and never reach the finale.
